description: This file defines an Express middleware function 'requireAuth' that checks for an authenticated user session. If the session is valid, it proceeds to the next middleware; otherwise, it responds with a 401 Unauthorized status.

methods.name: requireAuth(req, res, next)
methods.description: Express middleware to require an authenticated session user. Checks if req.session and req.session.user exist; proceeds if authenticated, otherwise responds with 401 Unauthorized.
